scientific_integrity: Each seed equality is independently replayed from the tabulated pair, the propagation implication is reconstructed from multiplicativity of phi, and the periodic union is counted exactly modulo the squarefree product of its 36 relevant primes using integer dynamic programming.
scientific_limitations: The exact density concerns the finite union of coprimality certificates generated by the 28 Table-7 seed collisions. It is only a lower bound for the density of parameters c for which (n+c)phi(n) is noninjective and does not prove noninjectivity for every c.
title: Exact \(99.681\%\) density from the full Table-7 totient collision envelope
